projects.title: Nyse Euronext offers issuers access to Equilar Atlas
projects.description: New York, NY (July 12, 2012) - NYSE Euronext (NYX) today announced a strategic partnership with Equilar, the leader in executive compensation and C-Suite mapping technology, to provide NYSE and NYSE MKT issuers access to Equilar Atlas, a comprehensive solution to help identify executive and board member candidates for potential hire and to maximize business networking opportunities.  Equilar Atlas is currently available through the NYSE Connect portal, a comprehensive and powerful dashboard of market intelligence and analytics tools, available to NYSE-listed companies.
